text:
maya: Quick sync - prototyping route+rollout metadata from gateway so Console can show live quota/exposure during canaries.
simon: Carrier? headers or proto metadata?
maya: Headers first for speed: X-RW-Route, X-RW-Rollout, X-RW-Rollout-Pct, X-RW-Quota, X-RW-Cache-Hit, X-RW-Tokens-In, X-RW-Tokens-Out
anita: Headers are easiest for ELT. Envoy dynamic metadata could attach route info to spans without changing services.
simon: Proto RouteMeta message is cleaner for gRPC teams but heavier to roll out.
tom: Security: gateway must canonicalize. Drop client X-RW-* and set authoritative ones. Also redact tenant before any external export.
maya: Gate will strip inbound X-RW-* and inject canonical headers + envoy metadata. We'll emit tenant_hash for Console mapping.
anita: Metrics needs stable join key: route_id + rollout_id. Also rollout_pct for expected exposure.
simon: Include cache hit tag so billing/Optimize can split cost.
tom: For gRPC, mirror headers into RouteMeta proto via an envoy filter so downstreams can read either.
maya: Good plan. Pipeline: gateway change -> ELT parser -> Console wiring.
anita: I'll own dashboard wiring: compare baseline vs canary (latency, error rate, cost per 1k tokens).
simon: I'll draft RouteMeta proto: string route_id, string rollout_id, float rollout_pct, bool cache_hit, int32 tokens_in, int32 tokens_out, string quota_policy. Put in common.proto.
maya: Timeline: small gateway PR today to strip/add headers + set envoy metadata; ELT parser next week; Console after. Canary targets: 5,10,25%.
tom: Add tests to ensure header stripping, metadata present, and redaction on egress.
devx-bot: Runbook stub: https://go.redwood/rollout-telemetry-runbook (created)
maya: I'll post design note and tag you on PRs. :rocket:
